salt-grain.name: pic_router
salt-grain.title: KLayout-PIC Router
salt-grain.doc: Interactive photonic integrated circuit (PIC) layout toolkit for KLayout 0.28–0.30+: PinRec port management and auto-detection, precision cell-to-cell snapping (including mirrored and arbitrary-angle ports), constant-width TOPIC (C3 Hermite), Euler (C2 clothoid), and C2 S-bend multi-layer waveguide routing, blank-canvas free-draw waveguides, single- and multi-layer trench generation, and length-preserving CD linewidth bias. Pure Python with zero third-party dependencies.
salt-grain.author: MeshedPoto
